sampleNote: This is a sample. The home below is made up to show the layout. It is not a real customer, and the drawings are diagrams, not photos.
verdict: Most of this sample home is ready. One point needs a repair first, and one switchbox has to wait.

boxes.name: Main switchboard

checks.label: Wiring condition
checks.value: Good. No loose or burnt wires seen

boxes.finding: Modules fit behind the existing switches. The fan regulator stays where it is.

boxes.name: AC and TV

checks.label: Wiring needed
checks.value: None. Works through the remote signal

checks.label: Appliances
checks.value: Split AC and TV, both with a remote

boxes.finding: The AC and TV both answered remote commands in our check.

boxes.name: Switchboard near the door

checks.label: Wi-Fi signal
checks.value: Fair. Works, but weaker than the living room

boxes.finding: Ready as it is. We note the weaker Wi-Fi so you know before you decide.

boxes.name: Geyser point

checks.label: Wiring condition
checks.value: Heat mark on one wire at the switch

boxes.finding: The marked wire should be replaced before any module goes in. We list this repair separately in the quote, and nothing is done without your approval.

boxes.name: Switchboard near the bed

checks.label: Neutral wire
checks.value: No neutral wire in this box

boxes.finding: Our current modules need a neutral wire, so we leave this board as it is for now. A No-Neutral Module is planned. We do not quote for anything we cannot fit.

safety.text: Heat mark on one wire at the switch. Replace the wire before installation.
